description: Per-area RESIDUAL salience on the onset-event stream (Rung 4 of the photon-eye migration). Salience is computed EVENT-NATIVELY as the RESIDUAL of the async onset-event stream (RetinalOnsetEvent, Rung 1) AFTER the coherent structure is explained: the salient column is the SURPRISING one, whose onset motion is NOT accounted for by the DOMINANT common-fate motion. compute-∝-surprise made into an attention signal -- salience = the residual (the under-compressed). This re-expresses the RGB residual-salience result (block 157000: the RESIDUAL after egomotion cancellation ranks the independent mover ABOVE the egomotion-swung background, where RAW salience fails) onto the EVENT STREAM: egomotion <-> the dominant common-fate velocity v_dom; a column's egomotion-cancelled residual <-> |v_run - v_dom|. This is the event-native replacement for raster salience (native shape_salience / order_n_shape_salience on the coarse retinal_field) -- no raster, no frame diff, the SAME input Rung 2/3 read. The `retinal_residual_salience` Rust task kind reduces events to one mean epoch per firing column, segments the sorted columns into maximal common-fate runs (the same segmentation the carve uses), picks the DOMINANT run (most columns; the coherent background) to define v_dom, and emits a fixed per-column stride-3 layout [fired, raw_salience=|v_run|, residual_salience=|v_run - v_dom|]. This rule matches every RetinalColumn against the done salience task and mints ONE RetinalSalience node per FIRING column (output[index*3+0]==1.0) carrying both scores, once per column-epoch via a salience_epoch guard. The RetinalSalience node (edged retina -has_salience-> sal) is the graph data the fovea (160000 FoveaCandidate / fovea_resolve ArgminUnique over Log(salience)) reads. No threshold on the salience value -- the fovea's log-weighted admissibility grammar decides. HONEST SCOPE: 1-D (an azimuth strip); a true 2-D salience map needs the retina extended to elevation columns -- a named follow-on. OFF by default: the rule cannot fire unless a RetinaSalienceParams node exists (created by the adapter only when context['visual_salience'] is set), and the adapter creates the salience task only then.
